items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: he and I knew each other, we used to hang out together -- went to Atlantic City. He was a good friend, man.

ctx.x: ... Anyhow I still get statements from them, now this is myself, Roy Eldridge, Percy Heath, Lloyd Glenn on the piano... and... Eddie Locke was on drums... I received a thousand dollars to make the date. I don't know what Roy got or the other people got. ... And so I got a thousand dollars for the date and to this day, every year or every six months or something they send me something that I still owe them. Now this is real weird... Now evidently I did the date for free... Out of the thousand dollars in six years…
When did you first meet Ike Quebec?

... The studio, Blue Note, arranged that we record together, but he and I knew each other, we used to hang out together -- went to Atlantic City. He was a good friend, man. We got things together and had a good session...
